entities.summary: Jude Thaddeus Okolo KC*HS is a Nigerian Catholic prelate who has worked in the diplomatic service of the Holy See since 1990. He has been an archbishop since 2008 and held the post of Apostolic Nuncio in several countries. A native Igbo language speaker and English, Okolo is also fluent in French, Italian, Spanish, German, and Czech.
